outlooks.summary: AREAS FROM THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS WESTWARD TO THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY WILL EXPERIENCE NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL TODAY. STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC. STORMS WILL ERUPT ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF THE ROCKY MOUNTAINS FROM SOUTHEAST WYOMING TO COLORADO...AND ADJACENT AREAS OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. SOME OF THESE STORMS WILL PRODUCE STRONG WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN ESTABLISHED SPLIT FLOW PATTERN WILL PERSIST OVER THE CONUS TODAY. A LARGE CUTOFF MID-LEVEL CYCLONE OVER NV/SRN CA WILL SINK SOUTH TOWARD THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY. MID-LEVEL SLY FLOW ON THE ERN FLANK OF THE CUTOFF...FROM THE SRN ROCKIES EAST ACROSS THE SRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...WILL BE WEAKER TODAY THAN ON WEDNESDAY. ELSEWHERE...A DOWNSTREAM BLOCKING ANTICYCLONE REMAINS ANCHORED ACROSS THE GULF COAST...WITH AN AXIS EXTENDING NWWD TO THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS. IN ADDITION TO A NUMBER OF CONVECTIVELY-INDUCED/ENHANCED SMALL-SCALE PERTURBATIONS ORBITING THE BLOCKING ANTICYCLONE FROM THE SRN PLAINS TO KY...A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OF GREATER AMPLITUDE WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE GREAT LAKES TO NORTHEAST/MID-ATLANTIC REGIONS THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY. WHILE STRONGER HEIGHT FALLS WITH THE ADVANCING TROUGH ARE NOT EXPECTED UNTIL LATE TONIGHT/EARLY FRIDAY...THE HEIGHT GRADIENT BETWEEN THE TROUGH AND THE GULF COAST UPPER RIDGE WILL MAINTAIN A CORE OF 50-60KT W-NWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW FROM THE MIDWEST TO THE MID-ATLANTIC.

sections.title: NORTHEAST/MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: AN ELONGATED AREA OF SFC LOW PRESSURE WAS SITUATED AHEAD OF THE GREAT LAKES TROUGH FROM SRN ONTARIO TO NY/NJ THIS MORNING. A WEAK COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE ONTARIO LOW SWWD TO NRN OH. ISOLATED OVERNIGHT/EARLY MORNING TSTMS IN NY/PA/NJ HAVE OCCURRED AMIDST WEAK INSTABILITY BUT PERSISTENT LARGE SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH LEFT EXIT REGION OF MID/UPPER JET. AREAS OF STRONGER SFC HEATING AND LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION SHOULD RESULT IN MODEST SFC-BASED INSTABILITY OF 1000-1500 J/KG BY AFTERNOON WITH POCKETS OF STRONGER INSTABILITY POSSIBLE SOUTH TO DELMARVA. GENERALLY WEAK INHIBITION AND PERSISTENT BACKGROUND ASCENT SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO AN INCREASE IN TSTMS WITHIN SFC TROUGH AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENTLY STRONG TO PROMOTE UPDRAFT LONGEVITY AND ORGANIZATION WITH LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: TN VALLEY THROUGH MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: THE SYNOPTIC FRONT WAS PRECEDED BY WIDESPREAD DEEP CONVECTION FROM OH WWD TO IL ON WEDNESDAY AND WEDNESDAY EVENING. LAST OF THAT ACTIVITY WAS IN THE PROCESS OF DECAYING ACROSS SRN KY THIS MORNING. A COMPOSITE OF RESIDUAL CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE FOCUS FOR RENEWED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON AMIDST STRONG TO LOCALLY EXTREME SFC-BASED INSTABILITY /SBCAPE FROM 2000-3500 J/KG/. STORM-SCALE ENSEMBLE GUIDANCE PLACES THE GREATEST PROBABILITY OF ORGANIZED STORMS IN A SWATH FROM THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS WWD ACROSS TN/SRN KY TO THE MO BOOTHEEL. STORMS ERUPTING IN THIS CORRIDOR WILL EXIST ON THE SRN EDGE OF 40-50KT MID-LEVEL FLOW WHERE BULK SHEAR IS FORECAST TO BE IN THE RANGE OF 25-40 KTS. EXPECT A MIXED STORM MODE WITH MULTI-CELLS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE. EXPECTED MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY AND STORM COVERAGE SHOULD RESULT IN NUMEROUS LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND EVENTS. PROXIMITY OF THIS CONVECTION TO STEEPER LAPSE RATES ALSO SUGGESTS A FEW VERY LARGE HAILSTONES AOA 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: FRONT RANGE TO CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: HAVE COMBINED THE PREVIOUS TWO SLGT RISK AREAS INTO ONE GIVEN LATEST GUIDANCE INDICATING GREATER STORM COVERAGE POTENTIAL FROM NERN NM ACROSS THE TX/OK PNHDLS. THE ENTIRE CORRIDOR FROM THE TX BIG BEND TO THE FRONT RANGE OF WY/CO WILL LIE BENEATH BROADLY DIFLUENT MID-LEVEL FLOW OF 25-30KT ON THE ERN FLANK OF THE LARGE CYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY. PRE-STORM CONDITIONS ACROSS THE FRONT RANGE DO NOT APPEAR SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFERENT FROM YESTERDAY WITH THE EXCEPTION OF WEAKER TROPOSPHERIC FLOW. NONETHELESS...OROGRAPHIC FORCING/UPSLOPE SHOULD AGAIN RESULT IN STORM INITIATION BY AFTERNOON AMIDST MODERATE INSTABILITY AND POCKETS OF SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE. EXPECT PRIMARILY MULTICELLULAR STORMS WITH HAIL AND DOWNBURST WIND POTENTIAL. STORM MERGERS AND POSSIBLE ORGANIZING INFLUENCE FROM DISTURBANCES EMANATING FROM THE MID/UPPER LOW COULD RESULT IN SOME POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH AND MCS EVOLUTION. FARTHER SOUTH TO NM/TX BORDER...IT APPEARS DRYLINE WILL ACT TO AID STORM INITIATION IN ERN NM WHERE FLOW ALOFT AND INSTABILITY ARE FORECAST TO BE A BIT STRONGER. ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD ENEWD INTO INSTABILITY AXIS AND POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS

outlooks.summary: AREAS FROM THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS WESTWARD TO THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY WILL EXPERIENCE NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL TODAY. STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC. STORMS WILL ERUPT ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF THE ROCKY MOUNTAINS FROM SOUTHEAST WYOMING TO COLORADO...AND ADJACENT AREAS OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. SOME OF THESE STORMS WILL PRODUCE STRONG WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM NY SOUTHWARD INTO VA
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE TN VALLEY... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF WY/CO SOUTHWARD INTO EASTERN NM/WEST TX...

sections.title: NY TO VA
sections.text: CYCLONIC NORTHWEST FLOW ALOFT IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE GREAT LAKES AND NORTHEAST STATES TODAY. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS RELATIVELY STRONG HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN NY INTO THE MID ATLANTIC REGION. THIS CORRIDOR IS EXPECTED TO SEE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL PROMOTE A FEW STRONG/SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. REFER TO MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 653 FOR FURTHER DETAILS.

sections.title: TN VALLEY
sections.text: FULL SUNSHINE IS OCCURRING ACROSS PARTS OF KY/TN TODAY...WHERE DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG. WHILE ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED...WEAK FORCING AND SUBTLE UPPER RIDGING SUGGEST THAT COVERAGE WILL BE LIMITED. THOSE STORMS THAT FORM WILL POSE A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. HAVE BACKED OFF ON HIGHER PROBABILITIES OVER THIS AREA DUE TO CONCERNS REGARDING COVERAGE.

sections.title: WY/CO
sections.text: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS LIKELY AGAIN TODAY ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF SOUTHEAST WY INTO CO. THE DCVZ WILL BE ACTIVE AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON...FOCUSING A RISK OF SUPERCELL STORMS NEAR THE DENVER AREA. STORM-SCALE MODELS SUGGEST CONVECTION OVER SOUTHEAST CO MAY BE MORE WIDESPREAD TODAY...POSING A RISK OF LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: ERN NM/WEST TX
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ONCE AGAIN ALONG AND EAST OF THE DRYLINE OVER EASTERN NM AND WEST TX. MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL ONCE AGAIN BE A RISK. ..HART/SMITH.. 05/22/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS WILL DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ALONG/AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT. A MODERATELY FAVORABLE COMBINATION OF INSTABILITY/SHEAR SHOULD YIELD ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 1-MIN RESOLUTION VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS DEEPENING CU AND SMALL CBS FORMING ALONG/JUST AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT STRETCHING FROM AROUND 25 S ROC TO ZZV...WITH THE GREATEST CLUMPING NEAR THE NY/PA BORDER. 12Z WRF-NSSL AND RECENT HRRR RUNS ARE CONSISTENT IN SIMULATING ISOLATED TO SCATTERED CONVECTION EMANATING E/NEWD DURING THE AFTERNOON. THIS APPEARS QUITE PROBABLE GIVEN ROBUST HEATING EVIDENT AHEAD OF THE FRONT WITH MLCAPE LIKELY REACHING 1000-1500 J/KG BY MID-AFTERNOON. LOW-LEVEL WINDS SHOULD REMAIN WEAK AND GENERALLY WLY. BUT UNIDIRECTIONAL PROFILES WITH SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SPEED SHEAR /N OF THE MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX CENTERED ACROSS THE OH VALLEY TO CNTRL APPALACHIANS/ WILL FAVOR SPLITTING STORMS AND WEAKLY ROTATING UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS ARE COMMENCING WITHIN PORTIONS OF WW 172. SEVERE TSTM WATCH ISSUANCE FARTHER S ACROSS PARTS OF MD/DE/DC/VA IS LIKELY BY 19Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED FROM ERN/SRN NY INTO CNTRL PA...WITHIN AN INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. EVEN STRONGER HEATING HAS OCCURRED S OF THE PA BORDER WHERE 17Z SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE RISEN INTO THE LOWER TO MIDDLE 80S. MODIFIED 12Z IAD RAOB SUGGESTS INHIBITION IS NOW NEGLIGIBLE. AREAS OF CLUMPING CU EVIDENT IN 1-MIN RESOLUTION VISIBLE IMAGERY FROM S-CNTRL PA TO CNTRL VA SHOULD EVOLVE INTO ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS BY 19-20Z...LARGELY SUPPORTED BY CONVECTION-ALLOWING GUIDANCE. WITH A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX CHARACTERIZED BY 500 MB WINDS AOA 50 KT OVERSPREADING FROM THE MIDWEST/OH VALLEY...DEEP-LAYER SPEED SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED UPDRAFTS DESPITE A PREDOMINATELY WEAK AND WLY COMPONENT TO LOW-LEVEL FLOW. ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR LIKELY AS FAR S AS THE VA TIDEWATER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS FORECAST TO INCREASE CONSIDERABLY DURING THE NEXT 1-3 HRS ACROSS THE NM ERN PLAINS NWD INTO SERN CO. A SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL LIKELY ENSUE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS...IN ADDITION TO A LOCALIZED LARGE HAIL RISK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS THUNDERSTORMS PREFERENTIALLY DEVELOPING OVER THE SANGRE DE CRISTOS AND THE RATON RIDGE. A SEPARATE AREA OF LIKELY BLOSSOMING ACTIVITY IS LOCATED OVER E-CNTRL NM. A MERIDIONAL-ORIENTED UPPER SPEED MAX OVER WRN NM AND A DESTABILIZING AIRMASS UNDERGOING STRONG HEATING WILL LIKELY LEAD TO CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE REGION BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS WITH UPPER 40S-UPPER 50S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS YIELDS MODERATE BUOYANCY /1000-2000 J PER KG MLCAPE/ AND THE REMOVAL OF APPRECIABLE REMAINING CINH SHOULD OCCUR BY 18-19Z AS TEMPS WARM TO THE LOWER 80S DEG F OVER NM. SUFFICIENTLY STRONG MID-LEVEL FLOW /30 KT/ OVER THE WRN HALF OF THE DISCUSSION AREA WILL SERVE TO ORGANIZE STORMS. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS WILL PROBABLY CONSOLIDATE LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. THE SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL LIKELY MAXIMIZE LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO THE EARLY EVENING WHEN COLD POOLS BECOME MATURE AND HELP FOCUS SEVERE DOWNDRAFTS WITHIN A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE MULTICELLULAR STORMS WILL POSE AN ISOLATED WIND/HAIL THREAT THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS ELY UPSLOPE FLOW INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS --ALBEIT MORE RELAXED THAN YESTERDAY-- AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF A DCVZ. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AT 18Z SHOW DEWPOINTS HOLDING IN THE UPPER 40S TO LOWER 50S AND THE BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL PROBABLY OFFSET APPRECIABLE DECLINE/MIXING OF DEWPOINTS INTO THE 40S. STRONG SURFACE HEATING ON THE E SLOPES OF THE FRONT RANGE AND HIGHER TERRAIN OF SERN WY HAS FOSTERED SCATTERED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THUS FAR. THE BOUNDARY LAYER E OF THE MTNS CONTINUES TO HEAT AND DESTABILIZE AND THIS IS RESULTING IN INCREASING THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS. MID-LEVEL FLOW IS MODEST /GENERALLY AOB 15 KT PER MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS/ UNDERNEATH A MID-LEVEL RIDGE AXIS...BUT MODERATE INSTABILITY PROMOTE THE STRONGER STORMS TO POSE AT LEAST AN ISOLD WIND/HAIL THREAT DURING THE 19Z-01Z TIMEFRAME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS WILL DEVELOP ACROSS KY ALONG A SWD-SAGGING COLD FRONT AND MOVE E/SEWD INTO TN THIS EVENING. ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE PROBABLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WEAK COLD FRONT EXTENDED FROM NEAR HTS TO CGI...WITH INCREASING CU/SMALL CBS FORMING ALONG IT NEAR THE CONFLUENCE OF THE OH/MS RIVERS INTO WRN KY. RECENT HRRR RUNS AND 12Z WRF-NSSL ARE CONSISTENT IN SIMULATING CONVECTION EMANATING E/NEWD ACROSS THE BULK OF KY/TN. WITH RICHEST SURFACE DEW POINTS /FROM UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S/ LOCATED NEAR THIS PORTION OF THE FRONT...AIR MASS IS LIKELY STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 2500-3000 J/KG. NEARLY ALL BUOYANCY IS PROBABLY RELEGATED TO THE MID/UPPER-LEVELS OF THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILE GIVEN A WARM NOSE EVIDENT IN MORNING RAOBS AND FORECAST SOUNDINGS NEAR 700 MB. ON THE FRINGE OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL WLYS...SUFFICIENT 0-6 KM SHEAR WILL EXIST FOR MULTICELL UPDRAFTS. BUT GIVEN PREDOMINATELY WEAK LOW-LEVEL WLYS AHEAD OF THE FRONT AND LITTLE SPEED SHEAR FROM THE MID TO UPPER-LEVELS...HODOGRAPHS WILL GENERALLY REMAIN SMALL. STILL...ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD OCCUR GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD STORMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP DURING THE NEXT 1-3 HRS. A LOCALIZED LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT MAY ACCOMPANY THE MORE INTENSE CORES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE OBSERVATIONS FROM THE TX PANHANDLE NEWD INTO NWRN OK HAVE RISEN INTO THE UPPER 80S AND LOWER 90S ALONG AND S OF AN OLD BAROCLINIC ZONE. VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS A GROWING CU FIELD WITHIN THIS ZONE AND A LIGHTNING STRIKE WAS RECENTLY DETECTED AROUND 1910Z IN THE NERN TX PANHANDLE. MODIFYING THE 12Z OUN RAOB FOR EXISTING SURFACE CONDITIONS OVER THE DISCUSSION AREA IMPLIES ANY SUBSTANTIAL CINH HAS LARGELY BEEN REMOVED THROUGH SURFACE HEATING. UPWARDS OF 1500-2000 MLCAPE AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES COULD RESULT IN A LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUST/LARGE HAIL RISK. IN ADDITION TO THE EXPECTED ISOLD STORM COVERAGE...MODEST LOW- TO MID-LEVEL TROPOSPHERIC FLOW SHOULD RESULT IN SLOW-MOVING MULTICELLS AND THESE FACTORS WILL LIKELY PRECLUDE AN ORGANIZED/CONCENTRATED SEVERE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONSIDERABLE MOISTURE/CLOUD COVER OVER THE TRANSPECOS RIVER VALLEY/PERMIAN BASIN SO FAR TODAY HAS RETARDED SURFACE TEMPS /UPPER 70S OVER SERN NM AND INTO THE MID-UPPER 80S OVER BIG BEND NAT/L PARK AS OF 1945Z/. DESPITE RELATIVELY TEMPERED MID-AFTERNOON TEMPS...POCKETS OF SUNSHINE AND GREATER HEATING WILL FURTHER WEAKEN THE CAP. OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS WILL PROBABLY INITIALLY FOCUS AREAS FOR THUNDERSTORMS. MODERATE CYCLONIC MID-LEVEL FLOW OVER SWRN TX WILL SERVE TO HELP THE STORMS MOVE OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS AND SUPPORT A MIX OF ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND PERHAPS TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL AID IN THE PROMOTION OF GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS. A FEW OF THE DEEPER/STRONGER CORES WILL PROBABLY YIELD A LARGE HAIL THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORMS WITH SEVERE HAIL AS THE PRIMARY HAZARD SHOULD PERSIST FROM THE HUDSON VALLEY SWD TOWARDS THE VA TIDEWATER INTO THE EVENING. A SUBSTANTIALLY MORE STABLE AIR MASS TO THE EAST IN SRN NEW ENGLAND WILL PRECLUDE ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED STORMS WITH A HISTORY OF SEVERE HAIL ARE ONGOING ACROSS BOTH OF THE WW/S. THE MOST INTENSE SUPERCELL W/NW OF ALB HAS PRODUCED SIGNIFICANT-SIZED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG ROTATIONAL SIGNATURES SUGGESTIVE OF A TORNADO. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE WEAK IN ALB VWP DATA...SUBSTANTIAL VEERING WITH HEIGHT AND AN ALMOST DUE SOUTH STORM MOTION YIELDS 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 100 M2/S2. WITH THIS STORM RIDING ALONG A N/S-ORIENTED WARM FRONT...LOCALIZED TORNADO POTENTIAL MAY CONTINUE THROUGH ABOUT 22Z. E OF THE HUDSON VALLEY...SURFACE TEMPERATURES ARE QUITE COOLER /IN THE 50S/ ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND. THIS SUGGESTS SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAINED CONFINED FROM NY WEST AND SOUTH. ..GRAMS.. 05/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS SOUTHEAST KS...AND THIS SEVERE THREAT MAY EXPAND GENERALLY EASTWARD INTO PARTS OF SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL MO THIS EVENING. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED BARRING AN INCREASE IN ORGANIZATIONAL/INTENSITY TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE MAINLY MULTICELLULAR STORMS EXIST IN A NORTHEAST-SOUTHWEST CORRIDOR ACROSS SOUTHEAST KS IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE FRONTAL BOUNDARY. SOME TOWERING CU IS NOTED IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY INTO SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL MO NEAR THE SURFACE BOUNDARY. ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF SOMEWHAT STRONGER WESTERLIES...CONTINUED CLUSTERING/GRADUAL COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT MAY CONTRIBUTE TO AN EASTWARD STORM PERSISTENCE/POSSIBLE EXPANSION INTO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE 1500+ J PER KG/ ACROSS SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL MO THIS EVENING. AS SUCH...ISOLATED BOUTS OF DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL MAY REMAIN A CONCERN. A WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT SIGNS OF INCREASING INTENSITY AND/OR ORGANIZATION WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITHIN SEVERE TSTM WATCH 174...BUT AN ISOLATED/BRIEF TORNADO MAY BE POSSIBLE PARTICULARLY ACROSS SOUTHEAST VA/CHESAPEAKE BAY VICINITY...AND PERHAPS INTO NORTHEAST NC /WHICH MAY WARRANT A SPATIAL EXTENSION OF WW 174/. SEVERE TSTM WATCH 174 CONTINUES UNTIL 02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TO STEADILY SPREAD GENERALLY SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHEAST VA/CHESAPEAKE BAY VICINITY. THE INLAND AMBIENT AIR MASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 1000 J/KG. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM THE LIKES OF WAKEFIELD VA SAMPLE THE RELATIVELY STRONG QUASI-UNIDIRECTIONAL MID/HIGH-LEVEL NORTHWESTERLY FLOW WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO AS MUCH AS 45-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR SPLITTING SUPERCELLS AND FAST SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS. LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY RISK. AN ISOLATED TORNADO MAY BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY OF THE PERSISTENT RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELLS...BUT SOMEWHAT MARGINAL MOISTURE/HIGH TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS AND MODESTLY STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR/SRH SHOULD TEMPER THE OVERALL TORNADO RISK. ..GUYER.. 05/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST INTO THE EARLY EVENING AS TSTMS SLOWLY SPREAD EWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD CONVECTION FEATURING SEVERAL MULTICELL CLUSTERS PERSISTS FROM ERN NM NEWD INTO THE WRN TX/OK PANHANDLES AND SERN CO...WITH NEW PROPAGATION OCCURRING ALONG CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES GENERALLY SPREADING EWD. ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SVR WIND GUSTS HAVE BEEN OBSERVED WITHIN THE PAST COUPLE HRS...INCLUDING A 64 MPH GUST IN CIMARRON COUNTY OK. FOCUS FOR NEW CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BE CENTERED OVER THE CNTRL TX PANHANDLE AS A WWD MOVING BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CONVECTION INTERACTS WITH THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL FROM WRN TX PANHANDLE CONVECTION. THE ENVIRONMENT HERE REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR ADDITIONAL OCCURRENCES OF SVR WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL GIVEN SFC TEMPERATURES NEAR 80 F AMIDST LOW-MID 50S F DEW POINTS. THE TREND FOR A SLOW GENERAL EWD PROPAGATION OF CONVECTION SHOULD CONTINUE INTO THE LATE EVENING HRS...BUT THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN A DIMINISHING SVR THREAT...ESPECIALLY AFTER 00Z. ..ROGERS.. 05/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DIMINISH WITHIN SEVERE TSTM WATCH 172...SUCH THAT WATCH EXPIRATION IS ANTICIPATED BY/AT 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS HAVE SHIFTED WELL SOUTHEAST OF THE REGION OUT OF SEVERE TSTM WATCH 172. SOME LESS-VIGOROUS DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED AND REMAINS POSSIBLE IN VICINITY OF THE NORTH-SOUTH FRONTAL ZONE AND RESIDUAL INSTABILITY AXIS. HOWEVER...FACTORS SUCH AS SOME OUTFLOWS/CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING...LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...AND WEAK SUBSIDENCE IN THE WAKE OF AN OFFSHORE-SHIFTING MID-LEVEL IMPULSE SUGGESTS ANY LINGERING SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN MARGINAL AND OTHERWISE CONTINUE TO DIMINISH. NO ADDITIONAL WATCH ISSUANCES/TEMPORAL EXTENSIONS ARE WARRANTED. ..GUYER.. 05/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE DEVELOPING TSTMS OVER THE BLACK HILLS. THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN QUITE LIMITED SPATIALLY AND A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR INDICATE A SMALL CLUSTER OF TSTMS ANCHORED TO THE TERRAIN OF THE BLACK HILLS OF LAWRENCE AND WRN PENNINGTON COUNTIES AS OF 2245Z. THIS ACTIVITY IS OCCURRING WITHIN A BUILDING MIDLEVEL RIDGE DOWNSTREAM FROM THE SWRN U.S. TROUGH. THE LOCAL ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP LOW TO MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 50S IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY IS CO-LOCATED WITH A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH AROUND 30 KT OF DEEP-LAYER WHICH MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO PROMOTE SOME MIDLEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION AND AN ASSOCIATED RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL THROUGH THIS EVENING. THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN QUITE ISOLATED OWING TO THE LOCAL TERRAIN FORCING AND LACK OF ANY MEANINGFUL LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT. ..MEAD.. 05/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
